verdicts.reason: A keeps headline-first reading order, but the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an illegible speck top-right, the five pills are scattered around the can in mismatched sizes (Pink Peppercorn and Wild Honey are tiny, Elderflower/Blood Orange large), and the shrunken CTA is squeezed in beside Wild Honey instead of standing out. B is worse: the CTA sits top-right above the headline so the reading order is backwards, the pills are fragmented into three places with wildly inconsistent sizes (a huge Pink Peppercorn pill and a tiny Rosemary stuck in the bottom-right corner), and the logo is again an unreadable speck.
